excerpt: A network of quantum nodes linked by classical channels comprised of k nodes each with n qubits has a state space of dimension k2n, whereas a fully quantum network linked by quantum channels has an exponentially larger dimension 2kn.
overview: This scaling argument supplies the source's central motivation for true quantum connectivity. It is not a measurement but a formal comparison between separated node Hilbert spaces and a fully connected quantum network, showing why inter-node quantum channels can matter even apart from any particular algorithm.
title: Quantum Channel State-Space Scaling
